calls.title: Growthbook <> FlowGPT - Sync
calls.summary: The meeting discussed the customer's need to reassess their experimentation platform due to high data volumes and the prohibitive costs of Statsig. With over 1 billion daily data exposures, Statsig's pricing and t+1 data latency are misaligned with the customer’s internal capabilities for real-time analysis, leading to a shift toward GrowthBook, which promises scalability and flexible integration. The customer seeks substantial savings from their Statsig contract renewal, exploring GrowthBook's lower pricing and advanced features while discussing integration with their StarRocks data warehouse. Overall, the meeting set the stage for a strategic partnership centered on reducing costs and improving functionality.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, Statsig, experiment traffic allocation, data warehouse, agentic AI, conversation-based experiments
